scen.name: Forced escalation — before Nov 3
scen.text: Our base case. Tehran reads Nov 3 as Trump's weak point and raises the cost before it: tanker seizures, a Gulf energy strike, a US-base hit or the Houthis on the Red Sea. Oil $110–130 into the vote. After Nov 3 the US pot cools; Iran's stays hot.

scen.name: Oman corridor deal
scen.text: Corridor signed by late Oct (market: 40%). Ships climb past 20/day, Brent toward $85, gas eases into the election. Pots cool together.

scen.text: Least likely, most dangerous. Iran's stated Plan B: seize 5th Fleet's home island to force carriers inside its 300 km missile ring. Everything boils at once: US ground response, Gulf-wide war, oil $130+.
scen.tells: IRGC amphibious moves at Bushehr / Bandar Abbas · Bahraini Shia mobilisation · 'Bahrain is our province' rhetoric · US Marines ashore in Kuwait (the stated trigger)

endsDef.Stuck: no signed deal, no regime change, door under 30 ships/day, fighting continues
endsDef.Signed deal: a signed US–Iran agreement (not an MOU, not a pause)
endsDef.Regime change: any leadership change in Tehran, including an IRGC takeover or Khamenei succession
endsDef.Bigger war: US or Israeli strikes on Iranian territory sustained over a week, or a Gulf-wide exchange, or US ground forces engaged
endsDef.Strait regime: passage resumes ≥30 ships/day under Iran–Oman rules or fees, no war, no signed deal
endsDef.Other: anything else (Houthi Red Sea closure, US unilateral pause, etc.)
